per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The disputes application UI must follow corporate UI guidance and match the look and feel of other internal applications to ensure consistency and reduce user confusion.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Screen transitions and common UI operations must complete with perceived latency under 5 seconds for small actions (e.g., navigating from case list to case detail).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must feel snappy and avoid unnecessary waiting/spinners during call-handling workflows to prevent disruption of customer calls.
The system must support at least 350 concurrent users during peak loads without perceptible performance degradation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall support 350 concurrent users without any degradation of performance in the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must be highly available — 'basically available all the time' — with maintenance scheduled in specified quiet-hour windows to minimize user impact.
Planned maintenance windows must align with existing team expectations: Mon–Sat 03:00–04:00 local time and Sun 01:00–05:00 local time, during which downtime is acceptable.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall be available 24x7x365 with the exception of the following scheduled maintenance windows. Monday â€“ Saturday 3:00am to 4:00am EST Sunday 1:00amd to 5:00am EST'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Transaction, cardmember, and merchant core data must be read from their authoritative databases (Statement Database, Cardmember Information Database, Merchant Information Database) for reconciliation and adjustments; caching is allowed only for read-only UI performance, not for authoritative updates.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Cardmember Information Database. The Cardmember Information Database provides detailed information with regard to a cardmember. All cardmember detail information must be obtained from the Cardmember Information Database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Requests that produce letters must be sent to the Print Letter Utility; the application must not handle printing itself.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Letters application. This will allow the Disputes application to request letters as part of the dispute initiation and dispute follow up process. All letter requests must be sent to the Print Letter Utility application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Account adjustment requests must be routed to the posting and billing system so that ledger changes occur in the billing engine; the disputes app must not locally mark balances adjusted without confirmation from the billing system.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The Disputes application shall interface with the Cardmember Posting and Billing System. This will allow the Disputes application to request adjustments to cardmember and merchant's accounts. All adjustment requests must be sent to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Role-based access control must restrict sensitive actions (e.g., initiating chargebacks, making account adjustments) so that only appropriate roles (program admins or senior reps) can perform them while frontline users have limited actions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: There must be segregation of internal and external user views: external support users must not be able to see internal-only notes or internal-only data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must maintain detailed audit logs capturing meaningful events (status changes, who initiated chargebacks, letters requested, account adjustments, notes) with timestamps and user IDs to satisfy managers and auditors and compliance requirements.
Audit trails must show who did what and when for notes, status changes, letters sent, and adjustments requested (including timestamps and user identifiers).

Role definitions and permission assignments must be governed jointly: the disputes product team defines role responsibilities while identity and compliance teams set permissions and segregation; the system must support changing role-permission mappings in response to audits.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI must preserve context when navigating (e.g., returning from a merchant profile to the original case view) to avoid disrupting calls and causing user errors.

Confirmation dialogs and critical-action flows must be unambiguous and prevent accidental duplicate actions (e.g., creating duplicate disputes), with clear outcomes to avoid error-prone confirmations.
The system must behave predictably and consistently both visually and in backend behavior (consistent data sources and error handling) so users can trust it.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Caching may be used for read-only UI performance but must not serve as the authoritative source for transaction, cardmember, or merchant data used for reconciliation or adjustments.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must provide predictable, consistent error handling and messaging so that identical failures produce the same user-visible result.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Integrations (Statements DB, Cardmember DB, Merchant DB, Print Letter Utility, Posting/Billing System) must be reliable and return correct, authoritative data; the app must detect and handle integration failures to avoid inconsistent state.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'
